Pixel OS v2.1.3 — Pure Retail Google PixelOS Stable Update for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• Compact Wireless Patch OTA (~40 MiB — no 1.81 GB full system re-download required!)
• Fixed Websites Not Opening in Chrome, Brave & Chromium Browsers: stripped Qualcomm vendor init.target.rc 'stop statsd' and hardened zygote_next's native species library (libzygote_species_android_native.so) so isolated Chromium renderer zygotes (*_zygote_native / NativeOnlySandboxedProcessService0) never abort on closed /dev/socket/statsdw FDs
• Zero-Freeze Cold App Startup & 4.14 eBPF/DNS Networking: preserved mainline 4.14 eBPF/DNS map initialization (netbpfload_414 + DnsBpfHelper) and libmeminfo 4.14 fallback
• Out-of-the-Box 4K 60fps & 1080p 60fps Hardware Gyro-EIS3 Video Stabilization: patched Qualcomm Spectra 380 CHI HAL (UsecaseVideo4kEIS3PreviewEIS2 + stream-order-independent binder) & pre-seeded Pixel 9 GCam 9.6 custom EIS sessions (32808 60fps / 32779 30fps) — works automatically in GCam 9.6 (0.6x/1x/2x) and third-party Camera2 video apps
• 100% Pure Google PixelOS Experience on Default Stable Channel + Opt-In 'iOS Style UI Beta' Toggle in Settings -> System -> System update
